normalizations.original: The apparatus simulates a one-dimensional SU(2) lattice gauge theory with dynamical matter on a chain of eight dressed sites with periodic boundary conditions. It exposes an adjustable time parameter and measures a time-averaged entanglement entropy. Determine the relationship experimentally.
normalizations.replacement: The apparatus exposes the listed experimental controls and readouts.

normalizations.original: Entanglement growth in a non-Abelian lattice gauge theory
A non-Abelian lattice gauge theory can exhibit different dynamical phases depending on the initial state. The entanglement entropy growth rate is a key diagnostic.
normalizations.replacement: Use controlled measurements to characterize the observed phenomenon.
